facts.claim: A wheelchair may be borrowed after signing a waiver at the front desk.
quote: Although the Main Library in Burlington and the Scheben Branch in Union already have wheelchairs , they are now available at the Hebron Branch, Florence Branch and Walton Branch.
Stop by the front desk to sign a waiver and borrow a wheelchair.

facts.claim: The library's locations page lists all branches as smoke-free.
quote: Each library location is smoke-free

facts.claim: The library says accessible parking is available at every location. This branch offers curbside pick-up.
quote: Curbside Pick-up is available at Main, Scheben and Florence, while drive-thru service is available at Hebron and Walton.
If you prefer to come inside and browse, accessible parking is available at every location.

facts.claim: The library welcomes a phone call in advance to discuss other accommodations. Every branch has translation devices for talking with patrons who don't speak English.
quote: Every branch also has translation devices to improve communication with non-English-speaking patrons.
And of course, a phone call in advance to discuss additional accommodations is always welcome.

facts.claim: For curbside holds, place requests through the library website or app and wait for notice that they are ready. Park in a designated space, call 859-342-BOOK and select this branch; staff bring checked-out items to the vehicle. Bring your library card.
quote: Browse our catalog online and place holds with your library card through BCPL’s website or app. Choose the library location of your choice for pick-up, and we’ll notify you as soon as your items are available.

Once your items are ready, head to your selected location and park in a designated curbside space. Call 859-342-BOOK and select Main, Scheben or Florence to notify our staff of your arrival. We’ll swiftly check out your items and bring them to your vehicle, all while you stay warm!
Remember to bring your library card for a smooth transaction.

facts.claim: The library’s June 2026 article described “accessible computer stations” at Florence as forthcoming. Their installation and specific features are not confirmed; ask before relying on them.
quote: accessible computer stations are coming soon to the Florence Branch.

facts.claim: A wheelchair may be borrowed after signing a waiver at the front desk.
quote: Although the Main Library in Burlington and the Scheben Branch in Union already have wheelchairs , they are now available at the Hebron Branch, Florence Branch and Walton Branch.
Stop by the front desk to sign a waiver and borrow a wheelchair.

facts.claim: The library's locations page lists all branches as smoke-free.
quote: Each library location is smoke-free

facts.claim: A second-floor sensory room offers calming activities and equipment, for up to five people or one family, in 30-minute sessions. Ask staff to sign in.
quote: Our specially-designed Sensory Room, located on the 2nd floor of Main Library , offers calming activities, tactile manipulatives, therapeutic equipment, and more.
It accommodates up to five people (or one family) at a time and may be reserved for 30 minutes.
Ask staff at the desk to sign you into the Sensory Room.

facts.claim: A social narrative is linked to help prepare for the sensory room.
quote: Review our Sensory Room Social Narrative and Sensory Room Policy before your visit.

facts.claim: The library says accessible parking is available at every location. This branch offers curbside pick-up.
quote: Curbside Pick-up is available at Main, Scheben and Florence, while drive-thru service is available at Hebron and Walton.
If you prefer to come inside and browse, accessible parking is available at every location.

facts.claim: The sensory room is locked between uses. Ask desk staff to sign you in and unlock it, and tell staff when you finish so they can sign you out.
quote: Ask staff at the desk to sign you into the Sensory Room. (It remains locked when not in use.)
When done, tell staff at the desk to sign you out.

facts.claim: The sensory room’s activity wall has three panels with tactile, visual and sound features.
quote: Activity Wall These three panels offer tactile, visual and sound sensations.

facts.claim: In the sensory room’s bubble-tube corner, coloured spots on the platform change the tube’s colour and start or stop its bubbles when pressed.
quote: Interactive Bubble Tube Corner The platform is adorned with colored spots which, when pressed, change the color of the bubble tube and stop and start the bubbles inside.

facts.claim: For curbside holds, place requests through the library website or app and wait for notice that they are ready. Park in a designated space, call 859-342-BOOK and select this branch; staff bring checked-out items to the vehicle. Bring your library card.
quote: Browse our catalog online and place holds with your library card through BCPL’s website or app. Choose the library location of your choice for pick-up, and we’ll notify you as soon as your items are available.

Once your items are ready, head to your selected location and park in a designated curbside space. Call 859-342-BOOK and select Main, Scheben or Florence to notify our staff of your arrival. We’ll swiftly check out your items and bring them to your vehicle, all while you stay warm!
Remember to bring your library card for a smooth transaction.

facts.claim: Sensory-room requests are first come, first served, in person on the day of use. The policy allows 30-minute slots followed by 15 minutes for cleaning; this is not an advance online reservation service. Library-sponsored activities take priority.
quote: Room requests are made on a first come, first serve basis and can only be requested in-person on the day of.
Time slots are in 30-minute increments, with an additional 15-minute cleaning time automatically added to the end of each slot.
Library sponsored activities take precedence over public uses of the Sensory Room.

facts.claim: The sensory room is not continuously monitored by staff. Children under 12 need a parent or guardian; guests whose disabilities affect decision-making or make supervision necessary must have a parent or caregiver throughout.
quote: The Sensory Room may be monitored from time-to-time, but it is not under continuous monitoring by Library staff while in use.

Guests of any age with mental, physical or emotional disabilities which affect decision making skills or render supervision necessary must be accompanied by a parent or caregiver at all times. Children under the age of 12 years require supervision by a parent or guardian.

facts.claim: Food and drinks are prohibited in the sensory room except for dietary or medical needs. Professional therapy requires library approval.
quote: No food or drinks in the Sensory Room, except for dietary or medical needs.
The Sensory Room may not be used for professional therapy without the approval of the Library.

facts.claim: Sensory-room use ends one hour before the library closes. Check the room’s posted schedule and holiday closures when planning a visit.
quote: Usage of the room must conclude one hour prior to the Library's posted closing time.

facts.claim: The cinema is on the Theater Level inside the Gallery Building. The property lists 859-261-6742 as the cinema contact number.
quote: Location at The Levee Theater Level inside the Gallery Building

facts.claim: Valet parking for Newport on the Levee is at the East Third Street entrance behind Brio Tuscan Grille. For parking questions, call (859) 888-2455.
quote: Valet parking is available via the East Third Street entrance behind Brio Tuscan Grille
For parking inquiries, call (859) 888-2455

facts.claim: The FAQ warns of rough gravel paths. It says the scooter-rental vendor left during the 2026 season and no replacement is confirmed; do not assume rentals for a future visit.
quote: However, our pathways are gravel so please expect rough terrain. We are not renting mobility scooters at this time.

The festival had a 3rd-party scooter rental service operating for part of the 2026 season. However, we no longer have this vendor. The festival is working to find a solution, but please be aware of this update.

facts.claim: The October 2026 guide places designated parking near the front gate; tell an attendant you have a valid permit. It describes three archways without steps or turnstiles; only one or two may be open, depending on crowds and time.
quote: The handicapped parking area is the first few rows nearest the front gate.

The front gate has three main entrances. All three may be open, or there may only be one or two open depending on the crowd size and time of day. All three archway entrances into the festival are the same and do not have turnstiles or steps up/down.
Handicapped parking is located near the Front Gate. Let a parking attendant know you have a valid permit, and you will be directed to a space.

facts.claim: The October 2026 guide reports an adapted stall at each restroom location and ramps to some raised restroom platforms. Stall dimensions and adult-changing equipment remain unverified.
quote: All restroom locations have a handicapped stall(s). A few of our restrooms sit on an elevated platform and have a ramp for access.

facts.claim: The October 2026 guide warns of the 10:30 a.m. entrance cannon and stunt gunfire at the Shipwreck Stage. These are historical guide timings; check the visit-day schedule.
quote: 10:30 am Front Gate | Opening Cannon: A real cannon is fired.
10:30 am, 3:30 pm Shipwreck Stage | Pirate Stunt Show: This show has stunt gun fire.

facts.claim: The October 2026 guide describes same-day re-entry with a hand stamp obtained when leaving. It also says water is available at both first aid stations.
quote: As a reminder, you are free to leave the festival at any point during the day and come back later that same day. Just make sure to get your hand stamp while exiting.
Water is available at both first aid locations.

facts.claim: The October 2026 guide identifies a steep hill between Market Square and Minstrel’s Grove, cresting at the Swordsmen’s Stage, and another in Upson Downs. Some booths may have temporary ramps to lay down on request; availability is not assured.
quote: One steep hill lies between the Market Square and Minstrel’s Grove, cresting at the Swordsmen’s Stage. The second is in Upson Downs between the New World Knoll and Poet’s Crossing.
Some booths may have temporary ramps they will lay down when asked.

facts.claim: The current themed-weekend page advertises ASL interpreters for Fantasy Weekend, September 11–12, 2027. Confirm interpretation for the specific show before booking; this listing does not promise it every weekend.
quote: Fantasy Weekend September 11 – 12, 2027 Fantasy Weekend September 11 – 12, 2027 10:30 am — 7:00 pm All things fantastical come to life this weekend! Join the Witches of Willy Nilly and the fairies as they enchant the village. ASL interpreters available this weekend

facts.claim: Service animals are allowed; therapy and emotional support animals are not.
quote: The Ohio Renaissance Festival allows service animals on Festival grounds that assist those with disabilities. Therapy or Emotional Support Animals are not allowed on festival grounds.

facts.claim: The October 2026 guide warns of grass parking, roadside drainage ditches, variable gravel and wet-weather mud or standing water. These conditions may affect routes differently each day.
quote: The festival’s parking lot is a rolling grass field.
please look out for longer slopes and drainage ditches around the paved roads.
The consistency, size, depth, and compactness of the gravel may be inconsistent through the park and may change day to day or within the day depending on conditions.
Wet weather can lead to soft earth and mud issues. Low lying areas of the park can experience standing water.

facts.claim: The October 2026 guide describes mostly standing-height food counters, some open containers and no trays. Carrying assistance is not established.
quote: Most of the food counters at the festival are at standing chest level. While some food options do offer clamshell containers for transport, many containers are open-face. There are no trays available.

facts.claim: The October 2026 guide places first aid just inside the gate and in Whimsy Woods beside Gryphon’s Nest. If unable to reach a station, ask official polo-shirted staff or at a pub.
quote: There are two first aid stations at the festival. One is located just inside the Front Gate, and the second is in Whimsy Woods next to the Gryphon’s Nest.
If you cannot get to the First Aid station, you can stop one of the Staff members in an official Ohio Renaissance Festival polo. You can also request first aid at any pub location.

facts.claim: The FAQ advertises the 2027 festival on Saturdays, Sundays and Labor Day, September 4–October 31, 10:30 a.m.–7 p.m. This is a future seasonal schedule, not year-round festival opening.
quote: We are open Saturdays, Sundays, and Labor day September 4 – October 31, 2027 from 10:30 am to 7 pm.

facts.claim: Mobile reception may be weak and public Wi-Fi is not offered. The FAQ recommends printing or saving a screenshot of tickets before arrival.
quote: We do not offer wifi at the park and the cell service can often be weak.
Print or take a screenshot of your ticket email before you arrive at the park.

facts.claim: The FAQ prohibits outside food and drink without describing a medical exception. Confirm necessary food or supplies directly before visiting.
quote: Can I bring food and drink into the festival? No. We have a no outside food or drink policy.

facts.claim: The FAQ says severe weather can rarely close the festival; announcements appear on the homepage and social media. Performances may change for safety even when the grounds remain open.
quote: In the rare event we do cancel, look for notice on the homepage and on social media.
The festival operates rain or shine, except in rare cases when severe weather or unsafe conditions beyond our control force us to close.
Our cast and crew work hard to ensure a rainy day is still enjoyable, with some scheduled performances adjusted for safety, if necessary.

facts.claim: Under the festival’s service-animal policy, staff are not required to provide animal care or supervision. Harnesses, leashes or tethers are required unless disability or task performance prevents their use; the handler must maintain effective control.
quote: Staff are not required to provide care or supervision for your service animal while on grounds. Service animals must be harnessed, leashed, or tethered, unless the individual’s disability prevents using these devices or these devices interfere with the service animal’s safe, effective performance of tasks. Should you not be able to effectively maintain control of your service animal, you will be asked to leave the grounds.

facts.claim: The premium-joust page describes covered, cushioned seating and calls that area accessible, without specifying wheelchair spaces, transfers or companion positions. Ask about the actual seating arrangement.
quote: Cushioned seating under the covered viewing stand
Premium Joust Seating is handicap accessible.

facts.claim: The premium-joust page lists $10 per person and purchase at the joust field, recommending early purchase before seats are reserved. Its video references 2022 and the offer has no stated season; confirm current price and availability.
quote: ORF 2022 Joust Team
$10 PER PERSON
Purchase tickets at the joust field. Buy early in the day before seats are reserved! Look for the Premium Joust Seating sign.

facts.claim: The Cincinnati branch lists grocery delivery and pickup through Amazon for Prime members. Confirm the available collection method for this store when ordering.
quote: Grocery Delivery & Pickup
Order what you need on Amazon.com, delivered to you or picked up at your store. Prime members only.

facts.claim: The branch lists café seating. Seat heights, backrests, clearances and wheelchair table positions are not described.
quote: Café Seating

facts.claim: The branch lists an Amazon Counter for assisted package pickup and returns. That service description does not establish assistance with personal care or moving around the store.
quote: Amazon Counter Assisted pickup & returns service for your Amazon packages.

facts.claim: For grocery pickup, the chain guide says to select the store and a one-hour window, await the ready notification, then check in through the confirmation email or Amazon app before arrival.
quote: Choose your store and a 1-hour pickup window at checkout that works for you.

After you place an order online, you’ll receive a notification when your order is ready for pickup. Before arriving, check in through your confirmation email or Amazon app to let us know you’re on your way.

facts.claim: The chain guide describes trunk loading for curbside orders, but warns that some stores require indoor collection. Follow this order’s instructions; a curbside bay at Edmondson Road has not been verified.
quote: With curbside pickup, we’ll place your order directly in the trunk of your car.
Make sure to double-check your email instructions as some stores may require you to go inside the store to pick up.

facts.claim: The chain guide says missed-window orders are held until store close; check in through the app or confirmation email when heading over.
quote: We’ll hold your order until store close. When you’re on your way, let us know by checking in via the Amazon app or your confirmation email.

facts.claim: The chain offers a checkout option to leave deliveries at the doorstep; orders containing alcohol cannot use it. This does not promise indoor carrying or unpacking.
quote: Customers ordering delivery from Whole Foods Market can select “Unattended Delivery” during checkout and your order will be left at your doorstep. Note, orders containing alcohol are not eligible for unattended delivery.

facts.claim: Whole Foods Market’s store policy welcomes service animals and excludes them from its no-pets rule.
quote: Whole Foods Market welcomes all Service Animals. Our "No Pets" policy does not apply to Service Animals.

address_quote: Store Address 2693 Edmondson Road, Cincinnati, OH 45209-1910

facts.claim: The venue says its indoor and outdoor venues are fully accessible, with ADA-compliant entrances and seating. Accessible, hearing-impaired or visually-impaired seating must be requested when you buy tickets.
quote: The Andrew J Brady Music Center indoor & outdoor venues are fully accessible, offering ADA-compliant entrances and seating. Patrons requiring ADA, hearing-impaired, or visually-impaired seating must specify their needs at the time of ticket purchase .

facts.claim: Seats in the ADA sections are sold on a best-available basis through Ticketmaster or the box office during its hours.
quote: Seating in designated ADA sections is available on a best-available basis. ADA tickets can be purchased on Ticketmaster.com or at the venue box office during operating hours.

facts.claim: Sign language interpretation is available on request at least three weeks before the event, subject to interpreter availability; email info@bradymusiccenter.com.
quote: The Andrew J Brady Music Center offers sign language interpretation upon request. Requests for sign language interpreting services must be received 3 weeks before the event and are subject to availability of an interpreter. Please email info@bradymusiccenter.com with your request.

facts.claim: The FAQ describes three indoor entrances: Race Street, the Tunnel Entrance under the Race Street turnaround, and steps from Mehring Way. The outdoor stage uses the Carousel Entrance on Ted Berry Way.
quote: There are three entrances to The Andrew J Brady Music Center: Race Street Entrance next to the turnaround on Race Street, Tunnel Entrance accessible underneath the Race Street turnaround on The ICON Festival Stage level, and the Mehring Way Entrance accessible by steps from Mehring Way on The ICON Festival Stage level.
There is one main entrance for The ICON Festival Stage at Smale Park: Carousel Entrance on Ted Berry Way near Carol Ann's Carousel.

facts.claim: Service animals covered under ADA regulations are allowed.
quote: Service animals covered under ADA regulations

facts.claim: On November 13, 2026, the FAQ still warns that the garage elevator closest to the venue is out of service. One answer directs visitors to Rosa Parks Street/Ted Berry Way and Freedom Way/Race Street; another names Race Street, Freedom Way and Ted Berry Way separately. Confirm a working route before travel.
quote: The elevator closest to the venue is currently out of service.

There are two elevators, located at the Rosa Parks St. & Theodore M Berry Way Entrance across from the Filson on Ted Berry Way and at the Freedom Way & Race Entrance in front of E+O Kitchen on Freedom Way.
Patrons who need to use an elevator from the Central Riverfront Garage should use one of three elevators: Race Street, Freedom Way, or Ted Berry Way.

facts.claim: Buying ADA-section tickets confirms that someone in the party needs reserved seating because of mobility or standing difficulties. The venue may ask guests in that section to remain seated throughout the event.
quote: By purchasing tickets for the ADA section, you confirm that you or a member of your party requires reserved seating due to mobility or standing difficulties.
To ensure that all guests enjoy an optimal viewing experience, you may be requested to remain seated in the ADA section throughout the event.

facts.claim: The FAQ lists medically necessary bags accompanied by the guest using them as a possible exception to the clear-bag policy; all bags are searched. Confirm arrangements with the venue before attending.
quote: Possible exceptions include: Medically necessary bags and diaper bags accompanied by the guest using them. All bags will be searched.

facts.claim: There is no re-entry at indoor or outdoor events. First Aid is on the Floor by the tunnel entrance, and a gender-neutral bathroom is on the right side of the floor.
quote: There is no re-entry for all indoor & outdoor events.
The First Aid area is located on the Floor by the tunnel entrance.
The venue is equipped with a gender neutral bathroom on the right side of the floor.
